title: mimic boxes are gone from the arcade and the career
why: His note (2026-10-18, in a raid at 2:12, build 30.73): "get rid of the mimics, its just too confusing". About one crate or locker in fifty hid a dormant crawler that burst out 0.8 s after you started to search it (v26.77, his yes of 2026-10-14; v28.xx the crawler came out away from you named MIMIC and the box spun away in a void swirl). A faint tick sounded as you walked up to one. All of it is removed: no box is a mimic, nothing ticks, no crawler comes out, no MIMIC line, no alarm, no swirl, and the dead functions isMimic, mimicWake, mimicTick and drawMimicVoid and the party mark that told player 2 about one are deleted. isMimic was a pure hash with no random draw, so the seeded stream and the fingerprint (ents 85/374, containers 165/593) do not move. There was never a settings row for it (applyCfg keeps only keys that DEF has), so an old profile that saved mimic on loads back as off.
now: Mimic boxes are gone: no crate or locker hides a crawler, nothing ticks near a box, no MIMIC line.
